The following events took place in '''56 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Nerra Ziveri]] turns control of the [[Almas Academy]] over to [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and disappears.<ref name="Ziveri">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that [[Nerra Ziveri]] disappeared 24 years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. It can therefore be deduced that Ziveri's disappearance took place in 56 BBY.</ref>

==Births==
*[[Rithgar]]<ref name="SEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Annileen Calwell|Annileen Thaney]]<ref name="Annileen Age">Annileen Calwell is established to be thirty-seven years old in [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]. The [[Del Rey]] [[Wookieepedia:The Star Wars Legends Novels Timeline|''Star Wars'' Legends Novels Timeline]] places ''Kenobi'' between the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] and ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', both of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, ''Kenobi'' takes place in 19 BBY and Annileen Calwell was born around [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].</ref>
